Yash's Film 'Toxic' Box Office Collections Near ₹300 Crore Worldwide

The film 'Toxic', starring Yash, has achieved a worldwide box office collection nearing ₹300 crore by its fifth day. Domestically, the film has crossed the ₹200 crore mark. While the film's worldwide earnings are approaching ₹300 crore, it has not yet surpassed this figure. The first Monday's collection is considered crucial for its performance. One report noted an 8.5% drop in collections on Sunday.
